blocks.x: How Applied AI & GenAI lands in Food Safety & Food Retail — the constraints that shape the build, the gated delivery pattern, and the deltas we commit against your baseline.

Food retail carries the consumer-facing safety duty: fresh-chain quality, supplier verification, recall readiness and waste economics. Telemetry and traceability turn compliance cost into customer trust and margin.

The pattern composes Multimodal AI & Vision-Language Systems, AI Proof-of-Concept & Value Validation, LLM Fine-Tuning & Model Operations from the Applied AI & Generative AI tower, wired into the unit's workflows (Cold-chain management, Supplier verification, Recall response) on Dataq Compass and Dataq Forge and Dataq Nexus. Governance inherits the sector frame — Food-safety regimes among others — with evidence generated by the delivery itself.

items: Align AI to P&L lines and risk mandates — a sequenced portfolio, not a pile of pilots.
One governed platform, many GenAI products: retrieval, guardrails and cost control as shared services.
Own your models: tune, distill and operate LLMs with measurable quality, controlled cost and enforceable policy.

blocks.x: At industry level, the same pattern

At Agriculture & Food Systems level this capability reads as: satellite+sensor+agronomy models per field with uncertainty bands (harvest and trading decisions informed early). The sub-industry page narrows it to the unit's workflows, regimes and KPIs.

Programs run on the fixed rhythm below, chosen so progress is legible from week one. Weeks 1–2 lock the baseline with your team: the current metric is measured, signed and stored as the reference for every later gate. Weeks 3–8 run the pilot on deliberately narrow scope — one decision path, one workflow, one plant or one portfolio — with a control owner named on your side. Weeks 9–12 industrialize what worked: runbooks, monitoring, enablement and a measured delta against the signed baseline. Anything that misses its gate is stopped or redirected with a documented decision, never quietly extended.
